title: Controlled-access by-law amended for Fountain Street North
subtitle: 2026 meeting calendar deferred to August 27; question on timing of first budget meetings for new council
overview: Regional Council met in a short special meeting to consider an amendment to the Controlled Access By-law 58-87. Council passed By-law 25-034, which adds access controls for Regional Road 17 (Fountain Street North) in the Township of Woolwich {{vote:m3}}. Controlled-access designations regulate where and how driveways and entrances can connect to a regional road.

The 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar was not decided. The Regional Chair deferred the report to the regular Council meeting on August 27, 2025, because it had been discussed at an earlier meeting and several members were absent. Residents will have to wait until then to see the 2026 schedule.

Because the calendar was deferred, the confirming by-law (25-035) was removed from the agenda. One councillor asked staff to confirm, when the calendar returns, when budget meetings would begin for the new council that follows the 2026 election. The aim is to help anyone considering running to know the timing. The meeting then adjourned.

decisions.item: By-law 25-034, Fountain Street North controlled access
decisions.detail: Council amended By-law 58-87 to designate and regulate controlled access to Regional Road 17 (Fountain Street North) in the Township of Woolwich, passing it in three readings {{vote:m3}}.

debate: There was little debate on the by-law itself; it was moved, seconded and passed without discussion recorded in the transcript.
The Chair deferred the 2026 meeting calendar to the August 27 Council meeting, noting it had drawn discussion at the previous meeting and that some members were absent.

One councillor asked staff to report back, when the calendar returns, on when budget meetings for the new council would start, so prospective candidates know whether meetings would begin in late December or in 2027.
Staff said the first budget meeting for the new council appears on the draft calendar, and agreed to look into it. The councillor also asked that the calendar be legible when it returns.
